func newServerForAddr(addr string, group []*Config) (caddy.Server, bool, error) {
	switch tr, _ := parse.Transport(addr); tr {
	case transport.DNS:
		s, err := NewServer(addr, group)
		return s, true, err
	case transport.TLS:
		s, err := NewServerTLS(addr, group)
		return s, true, err
	case transport.QUIC:
		s, err := NewServerQUIC(addr, group)
		return s, true, err
	case transport.GRPC:
		s, err := NewServergRPC(addr, group)
		return s, true, err
	case transport.HTTPS:
		s, err := NewServerHTTPS(addr, group)
		return s, true, err
	}
	return nil, false, nil
}
